REC Veterinary Physiotherapy provides quality physiotherapy and rehabilitation to Ruminants, Equines and Canines, along with other animals, across North Wales, Cheshire, North Shropshire and the Isle of Man. We provide a range of manual therapies, electrotherapies and exercise therapies to help return your pet back to their normal selves following injury or disease. Physiotherapy is also great for maintaining and improving your pets strength, performance and general wellbeing!
Why not get in touch today to inquire as to whether physiotherapy is right for your pet?
